claims.quote: Rett syndrome, a complex X-linked condition, affecting mainly females, is due to pathogenic variants of the MECP2 gene in most affected individuals.

claims.object_text: median age of diagnosis of 3 years
claims.quote: Analysis of 103 girls who fulfilled the clinical diagnostic criteria for classical Rett syndrome with a pathogenic variant of the MECP2 gene showed a median age of diagnosis of 3 years.
The most frequent MECP2 variant was c.502 C>T.
